descriptionZh: 拥有者可签到重置等待期或随时取回；超过未活动期后，任何人都可触发按固定份额向多个继承人分配。
descriptionEn: The owner can check in to reset the inactivity period or recover at any time. After inactivity, anyone can trigger a fixed-share distribution to multiple inheritors.

example.titleZh: 多继承人的签到型数字遗产
example.titleEn: Check-in digital inheritance for multiple heirs
example.scenarioZh: 拥有者把资产分配给配偶和两名子女，并设置 180 天未签到期限。每次签到都会重新开始计时；长期未签到后，任何人都可触发固定比例分配。
example.scenarioEn: An owner allocates assets to a spouse and two children with a 180-day inactivity period. Every check-in restarts the timer; after prolonged inactivity anyone may trigger the fixed distribution.
rolesZh: 拥有者：签到续期或随时取回
2–5 位继承人：地址和比例在部署时固定
触发者：到期后提交分配交易，但不能更改收款人和比例
rolesEn: Owner: checks in or recovers at any time
2–5 inheritors: addresses and shares are fixed at deployment
Trigger: submits the mature distribution but cannot alter recipients or shares
stepsZh: 填写拥有者、继承人、比例和未活动期限
TN10 可选择 1 分钟快速验证签到和到期流程
拥有者定期选择“签到续期”，生成同脚本延续 UTXO
超过期限后选择“到期分配继承”并预检广播
stepsEn: Configure the owner, inheritors, shares and inactivity period
Use one minute on TN10 to test check-in and maturity quickly
The owner periodically uses Check in to create the same-script continuation UTXO
After maturity, build and preflight the inheritance distribution
example.resultZh: 签到重置 UTXO 年龄；到期分配只能按预设地址和比例执行，拥有者仍保留随时取回路径。
example.resultEn: Check-in resets UTXO age. Mature distribution is restricted to the fixed addresses and shares, while the owner retains an anytime recovery path.
example.cautionZh: 1 分钟只适合 TN10 测试。实际遗产安排还涉及当地法律、密钥备份和继承人知情机制。
example.cautionEn: One minute is for TN10 testing only. Real estate planning also requires legal review, key backups and an informed-heir process.

requirementsEn: Reset inactivity with an owner signature, allow owner recovery, and distribute to 2-5 fixed inheritors after the relative timeout.

parameters.helpZh: 至少 0.5 TKAS/KAS，以满足当前标准存储质量限制。
parameters.helpEn: At least 0.5 TKAS/KAS to stay within the current standard storage-mass limit.

parameters.helpZh: 该钱包可签到重置等待期，也可随时终止契约并取回资金。
parameters.helpEn: This wallet can reset the inactivity period or terminate and recover the funds at any time.

parameters.helpZh: 添加 2–5 个不同钱包，份额总计必须为 100%。到期分配会在链上固定输出地址和金额。
parameters.helpEn: Add 2–5 distinct wallets whose shares total 100%. Distribution outputs and values are enforced on chain.

parameters.helpZh: 可选择分钟、小时、天或周；1 分钟仅用于 TN10 测试。签到会重建同一契约并重新计算 UTXO 年龄。
parameters.helpEn: Choose minutes, hours, days or weeks; one minute is for TN10 testing only. Check-in recreates the same covenant and restarts UTXO age.

invariants: Owner check-in recreates exactly one same-script covenant output minus a bounded explicit fee
Owner recovery terminates to the configured owner P2PK output
Inheritance requires the relative inactivity period and terminates into 2-5 fixed P2PK outputs
All inheritor shares are positive, total 100%, and conserve input value minus the explicit fee

conservationChecks: Continuation equals input value minus explicit fee
Owner P2PK output equals input value minus explicit fee
Outputs match every fixed wallet and share
Outputs total input value minus explicit fee
